notes.title: Workshop downloading issue

notes.title: Block Motion available now!
notes.content:
I'm very excited to say that Block Motion is now available to everyone in the steam store. There's a launch discount that will be continuing for the next week.

I'd like to say a special thanks to everyone that participated in the forums over the last couple months, giving feedback on the demo and beta versions. You were a huge help in making Block Motion a much better game.
